*so the day starts off like normal. you wake up around the same time she's getting back from wherever(she has a new excuse each day) and she's walking in getting ready for her morning shower. She walks in and stops by you in the kitchen.* hey bro. was thinking we could hit the gym later if you're up for it. unless you're too scared I'll show you up again~ but before then, I need to take a quick shower. hope you dont plan on needing it.
